Since February 10th

The Highlight Reel

Day one energy

Everyone wants in

Wherever we go, people just want to be around us. It's not us being extra — it's just what happens when our energy shows up in a room.

Wellness summit

Smoothies & big talk

Healf summit, iced lattes raised like trophies. You always make even a rooftop chat with strangers feel like the best part of the day.

Royal Ascot

Fascinators & full glam

Posing in front of the Royal Ascot sign like we own the place. Honestly — with that energy, why wouldn't we?

Somewhere pink and pretty

Another random door, another adventure

I've discovered more of this city with you in almost five months than with anyone, ever — every random door we duck into turns into something memorable.

Chelsea Market → sombreros

Two days that started with Chelsea Market

Chelsea Market first, then we couldn't make it to the Mexican restaurant for the sombreros. That kicked off two full days together — and we ended up back at the same restaurant for dinner the day after.

Elevator, mid-laugh

Caught mid-laugh, as usual

Half our best photos are just us cracking up in random mirrors. That's the realest part of you — light, warm, never taking it too seriously.

Vision & ambition

You know exactly where you're going

The ambition, the career you've built, how you've always shown up for your parents — it's not loud, but it's everywhere in how you carry yourself.

You're always there for everyone. Look at your heart, how big it is — the people you've helped, your community, the volunteering you keep showing up for. People feel it, the way you support them, the way you open your heart, the way you simply are.

You constantly learn. You want to be better, to help people, to be around, to evolve — and you will get there, with everything cut away that doesn't serve that. I can't wait to watch the future you're building for yourself. I'm sure you'll have everything your heart desires.
